items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: May Alex, the girl I was telling you about, the singer... she come to New York and was a sensation.

ctx.x: That's right. No, no, the only thing Duke kind of drew the line on, that's how we got Ivie, you see, May Alex, the girl I was telling you about, the singer, a very -- she come to New York and was a sensation. But she was a girl, you couldn't tell if she was white or colored.
Oh, yeah, you told me about that. That's why he had to get Ivy Anderson.
